name: ketshop-rules-tests
description: Testes das Security Rules (Firestore + Storage) no Firebase Emulator

scripts.test:rules: cp ../firestore.rules ../storage.rules . && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,storage --project ketshop-test "node rules.test.mjs"
scripts.test:admin: cp ../firestore.rules ../storage.rules . && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,storage --project ketshop-test "node admin-e2e.mjs"
scripts.test:android: cp ../firestore.rules ../storage.rules . && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,storage --project ketshop-test "bash android/run.sh"
scripts.test: npm run test:rules && npm run test:admin && npm run test:android
